title: Cleaning.
officialText: Section 13.2 of ANSI/ASSE A10.11 shall be deleted and replaced with the following: “Horizontal safety netting shall not be used for storing material. Horizontal netting shall be cleaned, at least daily, to remove any items that fall into the nets.”
